notes.title: Welcome!
notes.content:
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45551517/e164a1a17d00f033d561b13a49ab8c6a2e1e4209.jpg"]Hey everyone, and welcome!


This is the very first community post for Darker, so thank you for checking out the game’s page. I’ll be using these updates to keep you all in the loop as development moves forward.

The most recent progress includes the release of Part 8 and Part 9, which continue to build on the story and expand the Darker world. Each new part adds more hot scenes to an already large library.


Update Highlights:
700+ high-quality renders (2k resolution)

15+ new animations (1000+ frames total)

3 major route choices, leading to 10+ different variations

A fully integrated audio experience, including music, sound effects, and NSFW audio



I’m really excited to share more with you as things develop. If Darker has caught your interest, don’t forget to Wishlist the game. It’s the best way to stay updated on future releases and launch news.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45551517/626253a15a80ad8e3f8c1ec701bee2efcef1f9e8.jpg"]
